metadata.language: Hebrew / Aramaic only; English translations excluded
metadata.notes: Tanakh and Babylonian Talmud with available Rashi; all 63 Mishnah tractates with available Bartenura, organized by order, tractate, chapter and mishnah. No Rashi is added to Mishnah. Jerusalem Talmud excluded. Edition labels and traditional commentary attributions follow the source catalog.
